# Scraper de Idealo.de

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/idealo-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/idealo-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta dados de produtos do Idealo.de, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape idealo Price Comparison Data (2026)](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-idealo)
- **Código:** [`idealo.py`](idealo.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [Manufacturer](results/manufacturer.json) · [Price history](results/price_history.json) · [Products](results/products.json) · [Search](results/search.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Páginas de produtos do Idealo para dados de produtos e ofertas
- Páginas de busca do Idealo para dados de anúncios
- Páginas de fabricantes do Idealo para listagens por marca

## Funções

- `scrape_with_retry(config, _retries=0)` → `ScrapeApiResponse`: scrape a config and retry on any failure - idealo blocks requests intermittently
- `scrape_products(urls)` → `List[IdealoProduct]`: scrape product pages from idealo.de
- `scrape_search(query, max_pages=3)` → `List[IdealoListingItem]`: scrape search listings from idealo.de
- `scrape_manufacturer(url)` → `IdealoManufacturer`: scrape a manufacturer listing page from idealo.de
- `scrape_price_history(id, period, site_id=1)` → `IdealoPriceHistory`: scrape price history from idealo.de

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import idealo


async def main():
    products = await idealo.scrape_products(
        urls=[
            "https://www.idealo.de/preisvergleich/OffersOfProduct/207643424.html",
            "https://www.idealo.de/preisvergleich/OffersOfProduct/207644441.html",
        ],
    )
    search = await idealo.scrape_search(query="sonnenfinsternis brillen")
    manufacturer = await idealo.scrape_manufacturer(
        url="https://www.idealo.de/preisvergleich/Hersteller/1274.html",
    )
    price_history = await idealo.scrape_price_history(id="207643424", period="3M")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos:

- **`IdealoOffer`**: `shop_name`, `shop_url?`, `shop_rating?`, `shop_rating_count?`, `price?`, `currency`, `delivery_info?`, `merchant_name?`, `url`
- **`IdealoProduct`**: `product_id?`, `name?`, `brand?`, `url`, `image?`, `description?`, `rating?`, `rating_count?`, `low_price?`, `high_price?`, `currency?`, `offer_count?`, `offers`
- **`IdealoListingItem`**: `product_id?`, `name?`, `url?`, `image?`, `price?`, `currency`, `offer_count?`, `shop_name?`
- **`IdealoManufacturer`**: `name?`, `description?`, `url`, `result_count?`, `products`
- **`IdealoPriceHistoryPoint`**: `date?`, `price?`
- **`IdealoPriceHistory`**: `product_id`, `period`, `currency`, `start_date?`, `avg_price?`, `lowest_price?`, `lowest_price_days?`, `highest_price?`, `highest_price_days?`, `points`

Um campo marcado com `?` pode ser `null`.

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`idealo.py`](idealo.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"DE"`: país do proxy
- `render_js` = `True`: renderiza a página em um navegador real
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: pool de proxies (datacenter ou residencial)

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/idealo-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_product_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`, `test_manufacturer_scraping`, `test_price_history_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
